subtheme: Neighbouring entities (races, contests, expeditions, class rosters, teams)

balance.note: 21 is odd, so an exact half split is impossible; the extra task is unanswerable

what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/calibration/spec.md and tasks/calibration/dev.json; checked answer/number checker names in lab/core.py
Wrote the 21 tasks through a Python builder script (session scratchpad) using the spec's verbatim prompt convention, max_tokens 80, no system field, and the spec's checker patterns
Builder asserts each evidence passage is 25-60 words and prints the difficulty/label balance
answer_verification: Every computed answer is evaluated and asserted in Python in the builder: 58-7=51 (g2-04), 30+6+4=40 (g2-07), 6*2=12 (g2-13), 4-1=3 (g2-18), 24-9-8=7 (g2-21); tempting negatives are also computed (58+7=65, 30+4=34, 85+20=105). Lookup answers (31, 48, Brok Unnel, Glimmerwake, Rusk Hallen) are stated in or follow in one hop from the passage. Each unanswerable passage was reread for airtightness: the asked entity has no value and no relation that fixes one (g2-03 gives only 'some time before', g2-19 anchors an offset on an unrecorded score, g2-14 lacks one round's card).
not_done: No model run or pilot on these tasks (held-out), so baseline pass rate and difficulty labels are estimates from the spec's guidance, not measurements
Did not read other generators' files, so overlap with them is unchecked
